description: CIS Microsoft Windows 11 Enterprise Benchmark v5.0.1 (Level 1 & 2)

controls.title: Account Lockout Threshold
controls.description: Ensure Account lockout threshold is set to 5 or fewer invalid logon attempts.

controls.title: Guest Account Status
controls.description: Ensure Accounts: Guest account status is set to Disabled.

controls.title: Administrator Account Status
controls.description: Ensure Accounts: Administrator account status is set to Disabled.

controls.title: SMB Digitally Sign Communications (Server)
controls.description: Ensure Microsoft network server: Digitally sign communications (always) is set to Enabled.

controls.title: LAN Manager Authentication Level
controls.description: Ensure Network security: LAN Manager authentication level is set to Send NTLMv2 response only.

controls.title: UAC Admin Approval Mode
controls.description: Ensure User Account Control: Run all administrators in Admin Approval Mode is set to Enabled.

controls.title: UAC Behavior of Elevation Prompt for Admins
controls.description: Ensure User Account Control: Behavior of the elevation prompt for administrators is set to Prompt for consent.

controls.title: UAC Switch to Secure Desktop
controls.description: Ensure User Account Control: Switch to the secure desktop when prompting for elevation is set to Enabled.

controls.title: Domain Firewall State
controls.description: Ensure Windows Firewall: Domain: Firewall state is set to On.

controls.title: Private Firewall State
controls.description: Ensure Windows Firewall: Private: Firewall state is set to On.

controls.title: Public Firewall State
controls.description: Ensure Windows Firewall: Public: Firewall state is set to On.

controls.title: Public Firewall Inbound Connections
controls.description: Ensure Windows Firewall: Public: Inbound connections is set to Block (default).

controls.title: Audit Process Creation
controls.description: Ensure Audit Process Creation is set to Success and Failure.

controls.title: Audit Logon
controls.description: Ensure Audit Logon is set to Success and Failure.

controls.title: Disable SMBv1 Protocol
controls.description: Ensure SMBv1 protocol driver is disabled.

controls.title: BitLocker OS Drive Encryption
controls.description: Ensure BitLocker drive encryption is enabled for the operating system drive.

controls.title: Include Command Line in Process Creation Events
controls.description: Ensure Include command line in process creation events is set to Enabled.

controls.title: LSA Protection RunAsPPL
controls.description: Ensure Configuring LSASS to run as a protected process is set to Enabled.

controls.title: Turn Off Multicast Name Resolution (LLMNR)
controls.description: Ensure Turn off multicast name resolution is set to Enabled.

controls.title: Defender Antivirus Real-Time Protection
controls.description: Ensure Turn on Defender Antivirus real-time protection is set to Enabled.

controls.title: PowerShell Script Block Logging
controls.description: Ensure Turn on PowerShell Script Block Logging is set to Enabled.

controls.title: RDP Network Level Authentication
controls.description: Ensure Require user authentication for remote connections by using Network Level Authentication is set to Enabled.
